chunks: 4543 - Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl narrated from Shurays al-Wābishī, from Jābir, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: He said to me:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, did not assign ghayrah to women; rather, He assigned ghayrah to men, because Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has made lawful for a man four free women and those whom his right hand possesses, and He did not make lawful for the woman except her husband alone. So if she seeks other than him while she is with her husband, then with Allah, Mighty and Majestic, she is an adulteress. It is only the women who reject that show such jealousy; as for the believing women, they do not.

key_terms.الْغَيْرَةَ: protective jealousy or possessive concern in the marital context
key_terms.الْمُنْكِرَاتُ: those women who reject or object in this context
key_terms.حَرَائِرَ: free women, meaning legally wedded wives who are not bondwomen
key_terms.زَانِيَةً: an adulteress, a woman guilty of illicit sexual relations
key_terms.زَوْجَهَا: her husband, the only lawful spouse for a married woman
key_terms.مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُهُ: those whom his right hand possesses, referring to bondwomen in the classical legal context

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about ghayrah in marriage and why is it described differently for men and women?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks about ghayrah within the framework of marriage and distinguishes between the legal position of men and women in the marital bond. It presents this distinction as tied to the divinely ordained limits of lawful relationships and portrays believing women as accepting Allah’s ruling without objection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4543 - Muhammad ibn al-Fudhayl narrated from Shurayh al-Wabishi, from Jabir, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:

Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has not ordained jealousy (ghayrah) for women, but He (swt) has ordained jealousy for men, because Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has permitted a man to marry four free women and what his right hand possesses, whereas He (swt) has made lawful for a woman only her husband.
So if a woman seeks another besides her husband while being married to him, she is considered by Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, as an adulteress. Jealousy is found among those who act contrary to what is proper, but as for believing women, they do not exhibit such jealousy."
